_mode: manual = off until you run /autohandoff on (the arm marker outlives /clear, and expires after 7 days). always = every session in this project. off = never.
_atThreshold: stop = write the handoff, then stop and wait for you to /clear (cleanest context, two keystrokes). continue = write the handoff and keep working; Claude Code's own auto-compact reclaims the window and the SessionStart hook re-injects the handoff. Zero keystrokes, but the session carries a compaction summary rather than a clean slate.
_enabled: false is a hard kill switch that overrides mode.
_thresholds: percentages of the context window at which a handoff is forced; each fires once per session.
